subject: general
question: Who received the Arjuna Award 2021 for outstanding performance in the discipline of boxing?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Simranjit Kaur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Simranjit Kaur **

 
 
• **Simranjit Kaur Batth** is an **Indian amateur boxer** from Punjab. 
 
• She came up from an economically weaker family but has established a very bright career.
 
• She is representing India since the year 2011.
 
• In the year 2020, she also represented India in Boxing at **Tokyo Olympics.**
 
• She received the **Arjuna Award 2021 **for outstanding performance in the discipline of boxing.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhavina Patel:**

 
 
• Bhavina Hasmukhbhai Patel is a **Parathelete** and Table Tennis Player from Gujrat.
 
• At the Tokyo Summer Paralympics in 2020, she took home a silver medal in Class 4 Table Tennis.
 
• In 2021, she received Arjuna Award for outstanding performance in the discipline of Para-Table Tennis.
 
 
 
• **Monika:**
 
 
• One of the primary playmakers for the Indian **women's hockey** squad is Monika.
 
• She had played more than **150 matches** representing India.
 
• She received Arjuna Award 2021 for her outstanding performance in the discipline of Hockey.
 
 
 
• **Arpinder Singh:**
 
 
• Arpinder Singh is an** Indian Triple Jumper.**
 
• At the Glasgow 2014 Commonwealth Games, he won a bronze medal.
 
• In 2018, he won a gold medal in the Asian Games.
 
• He was amongst the 35 Arjuna Award 2021 winners, Arpinder won the award for his outstanding performance in the discipline of **athletics.**
